num2words Maintainer Phishing and Account Takeover

Target: num2words
Repository: https://github.com/savoirfairelinux/num2words
Date: 2025-07-28 to 2025-07-31 (3 days)
Attribution: Cybercriminal gang
Component: Library
Language: Python
Cause: Social Engineering
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft
User Impact: 50000
Domain: pypi.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attackers executed a sophisticated phishing campaign targeting PyPI maintainers using a lookalike domain (pypj.org). They successfully stole a maintainer's credentials and 2FA codes, generated a new API token, and uploaded malicious versions (0.5.15 and 0.5.16) of the legitimate package containing a Scavenger Loader DLL to exfiltrate sensitive data.

Compromised Versions

  • 0.5.15
  • 0.5.16
